title: Holy Spirit Novena
description: The original novena of the Church, prayed from Ascension Thursday to Pentecost. This is the most ancient novena, commemorating the nine days the Blessed Virgin Mary and the Apostles spent in prayer in the Upper Room awaiting the descent of the Holy Spirit. Each day focuses on one of the Seven Gifts of the Holy Spirit, culminating in the celebration of Pentecost.
saint: Holy Spirit (Third Person of the Trinity)
intention: For the seven gifts of the Holy Spirit: wisdom, understanding, counsel, fortitude, knowledge, piety, and fear of the Lord; for renewal in the Spirit and the fruits of the Spirit in our lives
instructions: This novena is traditionally prayed from the Friday after Ascension Thursday until the Saturday before Pentecost Sunday (9 days). Begin by making the Sign of the Cross and invoking the Holy Spirit. Each day focuses on one of the seven gifts of the Holy Spirit, with the final days focusing on the fruits of the Spirit and the fullness of Pentecost. Include your personal intentions as you pray.
background_info: The Holy Spirit Novena is the original novena of the Catholic Church. After Jesus ascended into heaven, the Apostles and Mary gathered in the Upper Room and devoted themselves to prayer for nine days (Acts 1:14). On the tenth day, Pentecost, the Holy Spirit descended upon them with tongues of fire, empowering them to preach the Gospel to all nations. This nine-day period of prayer became the model for all other novenas. The Seven Gifts of the Holy Spirit, prophesied in Isaiah 11:2-3, are bestowed in Baptism and strengthened in Confirmation. The traditional prayers include the Veni Sancte Spiritus (Come Holy Spirit) and the Veni Creator Spiritus (Come Creator Spirit), ancient hymns invoking the Spirit's presence.

days.title: Day 1: The Gift of Holy Fear (Fear of the Lord)
days.opening_prayer:
Veni Sancte Spiritus

Come, Holy Spirit, fill the hearts of Your faithful and kindle in them the fire of Your love.
V. Send forth Your Spirit, and they shall be created.
R. And You shall renew the face of the earth.

Let us pray: O God, who have taught the hearts of the faithful by the light of the Holy Spirit, grant that in the same Spirit we may be truly wise and ever rejoice in His consolation. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.
days.daily_prayer:
Holy Spirit, divine Guest of my soul, I adore You as my true God. I thank You for having sanctified me by Your grace, and for having chosen me to be Your temple. Today I implore You to bestow upon me the Gift of Holy Fear.

Holy Fear is that filial reverence which makes me dread the slightest offense against God. It is not a fear that drives me away, but a reverent awe that draws me closer to You. This gift purifies my heart and helps me to avoid sin, not from dread of punishment, but from love of You whom I never wish to offend.

Come, Holy Spirit, and fill me with this holy reverence. May I never grow so comfortable with Your presence that I forget Your majesty. May Your fear be the beginning of my wisdom, guarding my heart against presumption and pride. Make me sensitive to the smallest whisper of sin, that I may turn quickly back to You.

Veni Creator Spiritus (Stanza 1-2)

Come, Holy Ghost, Creator blest,
And in our hearts take up Thy rest;
Come with Thy grace and heavenly aid,
To fill the hearts which Thou hast made.

Kindle our senses from above,
And make our hearts o'erflow with love;
With patience firm and virtue high
The weakness of our flesh supply.
days.closing_prayer: O Holy Spirit, Spirit of love and truth, pour into our hearts the fear of the Lord, that we may avoid sin not from terror but from reverent love. May this gift keep us humble, contrite, and ever mindful of Your holy presence. Through Christ our Lord. Amen. Come, Holy Spirit! Fill the hearts of Your faithful and kindle in us the fire of Your love.
days.reflection: The Gift of Holy Fear is the foundation of the spiritual life. It is not servile fear, which dreads punishment, but filial fear, which dreads offending the One we love. This gift helps us to be vigilant against temptation and to approach God with profound reverence. It protects us from presumption and keeps us humble before God's majesty. When we truly love someone, we fear hurting them - this is the essence of holy fear.
days.intention_prayer: Holy Spirit, grant me the Gift of Holy Fear. Help me to approach God with reverent awe and to flee from anything that would offend Him. Let this fear be born of love, not dread, that I may grow in holiness. [Pause for personal intentions]
days.scripture: "The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom, and the knowledge of the Holy One is understanding." - Proverbs 9:10

days.title: Day 2: The Gift of Piety
days.opening_prayer:
Veni Sancte Spiritus

Come, Holy Spirit, fill the hearts of Your faithful and kindle in them the fire of Your love.
V. Send forth Your Spirit, and they shall be created.
R. And You shall renew the face of the earth.

Let us pray: O God, who have taught the hearts of the faithful by the light of the Holy Spirit, grant that in the same Spirit we may be truly wise and ever rejoice in His consolation. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.
days.daily_prayer:
Holy Spirit, divine Consoler, I adore You as the Soul of my soul. I thank You for Your presence within me and for all the gifts You have given me. Today I implore You to bestow upon me the Gift of Piety.

Piety is that gift which makes me love God as my Father and gives me a tender devotion toward Him. It moves me to worship Him with sincere affection and to serve Him with childlike confidence. This gift makes prayer sweet and easy, and fills me with a loving zeal for all that belongs to His service and glory.

Come, Holy Spirit, and inflame my heart with this divine affection. Teach me to love God not only as my Creator and Judge, but as my loving Father. May I approach Him with the trust and simplicity of a child. Help me to find joy in prayer and consolation in worship. Make me eager to serve Him not from duty but from delight.

Veni Creator Spiritus (Stanza 3-4)

Far from us drive our deadly foe,
True peace unto us bring;
And through all perils lead us safe
To heaven's eternal spring.

Through Thee may we the Father know,
Through Thee the eternal Son,
Thee also, Spirit of them both,
We worship, every one.
days.closing_prayer: O Holy Spirit, Spirit of adoption and love, pour into our hearts the Gift of Piety, that we may love God as our Father and serve Him with filial joy. May we find our greatest happiness in His presence and our deepest peace in His service. Through Christ our Lord. Amen. Come, Holy Spirit! Fill the hearts of Your faithful and kindle in us the fire of Your love.
days.reflection: The Gift of Piety perfects the virtue of justice toward God. It makes us relate to God not as servants but as beloved children. This gift transforms our prayer from duty into delight and our service from obligation into love. Piety also extends to devotion to the Blessed Mother, the saints, and holy things - all that belongs to God's house and family.
days.intention_prayer: Holy Spirit, grant me the Gift of Piety. Help me to love God as my Father with a warm, tender, and confident love. May prayer become my joy and service my delight. Draw me close to Your heart and make me a true child of God. [Pause for personal intentions]
days.scripture: "For you did not receive the spirit of slavery to fall back into fear, but you have received the spirit of sonship. When we cry, 'Abba! Father!' it is the Spirit himself bearing witness with our spirit that we are children of God." - Romans 8:15-16

days.title: Day 3: The Gift of Knowledge
days.opening_prayer:
Veni Sancte Spiritus

Come, Holy Spirit, fill the hearts of Your faithful and kindle in them the fire of Your love.
V. Send forth Your Spirit, and they shall be created.
R. And You shall renew the face of the earth.

Let us pray: O God, who have taught the hearts of the faithful by the light of the Holy Spirit, grant that in the same Spirit we may be truly wise and ever rejoice in His consolation. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.
days.daily_prayer:
Holy Spirit, divine Teacher and Guide, I adore You as the source of all truth. I thank You for the light of faith You have given me. Today I implore You to bestow upon me the Gift of Knowledge.

Knowledge is that gift which enables me to see the hand of God in all things and to judge created things according to their true value in relation to God. It helps me to recognize my nothingness and God's allness. This gift gives me a deeper understanding of the mysteries of faith and teaches me to use all created things according to God's will.

Come, Holy Spirit, and enlighten my mind with this divine knowledge. Show me the vanity of all earthly things apart from God. Help me to see Your providence in every circumstance of life. Teach me to use the things of this world without being enslaved by them. May I recognize in all creation a reflection of Your beauty and goodness.

Veni Creator Spiritus (Stanza 5-6)

O Comforter, abide with us!
Our souls with grace divine;
Fill Thou the air with heavenly fire,
And bring forth Thee in shine.

Eternal glory be to Thee,
The Father, and the Son;
The same to Thee, great Comforter,
While endless ages run.
days.closing_prayer: O Holy Spirit, Spirit of truth and light, pour into our minds the Gift of Knowledge, that we may see all things in relation to You. Teach us to use the world without loving it, to appreciate creation without being attached to it, and to find Your presence everywhere. Through Christ our Lord. Amen. Come, Holy Spirit! Fill the hearts of Your faithful and kindle in us the fire of Your love.
days.reflection: The Gift of Knowledge helps us see the Creator through creation, to understand the proper use of created things, and to recognize the emptiness of worldly pursuits apart from God. It is a light that reveals the relative value of all things - high in themselves, but nothing compared to God. This gift helps us navigate life with proper perspective and detachment.
days.intention_prayer: Holy Spirit, grant me the Gift of Knowledge. Help me to see Your hand in all things and to judge everything by its true value. May I understand the mysteries of faith more deeply and use all creation to glorify You. [Pause for personal intentions]
days.scripture: "For the Spirit searches everything, even the depths of God. For what person knows a man's thoughts except the spirit of the man which is in him? So also no one comprehends the thoughts of God except the Spirit of God." - 1 Corinthians 2:10-11

days.title: Day 4: The Gift of Fortitude
days.opening_prayer:
Veni Sancte Spiritus

Come, Holy Spirit, fill the hearts of Your faithful and kindle in them the fire of Your love.
V. Send forth Your Spirit, and they shall be created.
R. And You shall renew the face of the earth.

Let us pray: O God, who have taught the hearts of the faithful by the light of the Holy Spirit, grant that in the same Spirit we may be truly wise and ever rejoice in His consolation. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.
days.daily_prayer:
Holy Spirit, divine Strength and Power, I adore You as the source of all courage. I thank You for the strength You have given me to persevere in faith. Today I implore You to bestow upon me the Gift of Fortitude.

Fortitude is that gift which gives me courage to overcome every obstacle in the service of God. It strengthens me against fear and cowardice, and enables me to face difficulties, dangers, and even death for the sake of Christ. This gift makes the soul strong and constant in doing good, even when it requires sacrifice and suffering.

Come, Holy Spirit, and fill me with Your divine strength. Help me to be brave in professing my faith, even when the world opposes me. Give me courage to say no to sin and yes to virtue, regardless of the cost. Make me steadfast in trials, patient in suffering, and faithful to the end. Remember the martyrs who witnessed to You with their blood, and may I have their courage in my daily battles.

Prayer for Courage

Holy Spirit, give me the courage of the martyrs who faced death rather than deny You. Give me the strength to bear witness to my faith in my daily life, to resist temptation, and to persevere in doing good. May I never be ashamed of the Gospel or afraid to stand for truth. Strengthen me to carry my cross daily and follow Christ with unwavering resolve.
days.closing_prayer: O Holy Spirit, Spirit of power and courage, pour into our souls the Gift of Fortitude, that we may be strong in faith, steadfast in hope, and unwavering in charity. Give us the courage of the martyrs and the perseverance of the saints. Through Christ our Lord. Amen. Come, Holy Spirit! Fill the hearts of Your faithful and kindle in us the fire of Your love.
days.reflection: The Gift of Fortitude strengthens the virtue of courage to a heroic degree. It was this gift that sustained the martyrs through unimaginable torments and gives ordinary Christians the strength to face daily struggles with patience and faith. Fortitude doesn't remove fear, but gives us the strength to act nobly in spite of fear, and to endure suffering for the sake of what is good.
days.intention_prayer: Holy Spirit, grant me the Gift of Fortitude. Give me courage to face every trial, strength to resist every temptation, and perseverance to run the race to the end. Make me a faithful witness to Christ in all circumstances. [Pause for personal intentions]
days.scripture: "For God did not give us a spirit of timidity but a spirit of power and love and self-control." - 2 Timothy 1:7

days.title: Day 5: The Gift of Counsel
days.opening_prayer:
Veni Sancte Spiritus

Come, Holy Spirit, fill the hearts of Your faithful and kindle in them the fire of Your love.
V. Send forth Your Spirit, and they shall be created.
R. And You shall renew the face of the earth.

Let us pray: O God, who have taught the hearts of the faithful by the light of the Holy Spirit, grant that in the same Spirit we may be truly wise and ever rejoice in His consolation. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.
days.daily_prayer:
Holy Spirit, divine Counselor and Guide, I adore You as the source of all right judgment. I thank You for the guidance You have given me throughout my life. Today I implore You to bestow upon me the Gift of Counsel.

Counsel is that gift which enables me to be directed by the Holy Spirit in all my choices, especially those relating to my eternal salvation. It helps me to discern God's will in difficult situations and to make the right decisions when faced with doubt and perplexity. This gift makes me attentive to the inspirations of the Spirit and docile to His guidance.

Come, Holy Spirit, and be my Guide in all things. Enlighten me when I am confused, direct me when I am uncertain, and help me to choose always what is most pleasing to You. Do not let me be led by my own passions, by the opinions of others, or by worldly wisdom. May Your voice be the one I hear above all others, and may I follow it with prompt obedience.

Prayer for Guidance

Holy Spirit, You are my Counselor and dearest Friend. I surrender my decisions to You, trusting that You know what is best for my soul. Silence within me all other voices - the voice of fear, of pride, of selfish desire - and speak clearly to my heart. Help me to seek wise counsel from those You have placed in my life, and to recognize Your voice in their guidance.
days.closing_prayer: O Holy Spirit, Spirit of counsel and guidance, pour into our souls this precious gift, that we may always know and choose Your holy will. Be our light in darkness, our compass in uncertainty, and our guide on the path to heaven. Through Christ our Lord. Amen. Come, Holy Spirit! Fill the hearts of Your faithful and kindle in us the fire of Your love.
days.reflection: The Gift of Counsel is sometimes called the 'gift of right judgment.' It helps us make decisions aligned with God's will, especially in moments of uncertainty or moral complexity. This gift works through our conscience, making it sensitive to God's promptings. It doesn't replace prudence but perfects it, helping us respond quickly and confidently to the Spirit's guidance.
days.intention_prayer: Holy Spirit, grant me the Gift of Counsel. Be my Guide in every decision, especially those that affect my soul's salvation. Help me to hear Your voice clearly and to follow Your direction without hesitation. [Pause for personal intentions]
days.scripture: "But the Counselor, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, he will teach you all things, and bring to your remembrance all that I have said to you." - John 14:26

days.title: Day 6: The Gift of Understanding
days.opening_prayer:
Veni Sancte Spiritus

Come, Holy Spirit, fill the hearts of Your faithful and kindle in them the fire of Your love.
V. Send forth Your Spirit, and they shall be created.
R. And You shall renew the face of the earth.

Let us pray: O God, who have taught the hearts of the faithful by the light of the Holy Spirit, grant that in the same Spirit we may be truly wise and ever rejoice in His consolation. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.
days.daily_prayer:
Holy Spirit, divine Light and Wisdom, I adore You as the illuminator of souls. I thank You for every grace of understanding You have given me. Today I implore You to bestow upon me the Gift of Understanding.

Understanding is that gift which enables me to penetrate deeply into the mysteries of faith, to see with the eyes of the soul what the mind cannot grasp. It gives me insight into the hidden meanings of Scripture, the truths of doctrine, and the mysteries of Christ's life. This gift makes the truths of faith living and real, not just abstract concepts.

Come, Holy Spirit, and open the eyes of my soul. Penetrate my mind with Your divine light. Help me to understand what You have revealed, to grasp the meaning of the Scriptures, and to appreciate the mysteries of faith. Show me the beauty of the truths I believe, and make them the foundation of my life. Open my heart to the depth of Your love and the wonder of Your plan for my salvation.

Prayer for Deeper Faith

Holy Spirit, enlighten my mind to understand the mysteries of faith, especially the mysteries of the Blessed Trinity, the Incarnation, and the Eucharist. Help me to see beyond what is visible, to pierce the veil of the sacraments, and to encounter the living Christ in my prayer. May my understanding of Your truth lead me ever deeper into love.
days.closing_prayer: O Holy Spirit, Spirit of understanding and light, pour into our souls this precious gift, that we may penetrate the mysteries of faith and see with the eyes of the soul. Illuminate our minds, warm our hearts, and deepen our appreciation for all that You have revealed. Through Christ our Lord. Amen. Come, Holy Spirit! Fill the hearts of Your faithful and kindle in us the fire of Your love.
days.reflection: The Gift of Understanding gives us a supernatural penetration into divine truths. While knowledge helps us judge created things, understanding helps us grasp the meaning of revealed truths. It's a penetrating light that reveals the hidden depths of Scripture, doctrine, and the mysteries of Christ. This gift led the Apostles to understand the Old Testament in light of Christ.
days.intention_prayer: Holy Spirit, grant me the Gift of Understanding. Open the eyes of my soul to penetrate the mysteries of faith. Help me to understand Scripture deeply, to appreciate the sacraments fully, and to see Christ more clearly in all things. [Pause for personal intentions]
days.scripture: "Open my eyes, that I may behold wondrous things out of your law." - Psalm 119:18

days.title: Day 7: The Gift of Wisdom
days.opening_prayer:
Veni Sancte Spiritus

Come, Holy Spirit, fill the hearts of Your faithful and kindle in them the fire of Your love.
V. Send forth Your Spirit, and they shall be created.
R. And You shall renew the face of the earth.

Let us pray: O God, who have taught the hearts of the faithful by the light of the Holy Spirit, grant that in the same Spirit we may be truly wise and ever rejoice in His consolation. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.
days.daily_prayer:
Holy Spirit, divine Wisdom and the highest of Your gifts, I adore You as the source of all true wisdom. I thank You for every moment of divine insight You have granted me. Today I implore You to bestow upon me the Gift of Wisdom.

Wisdom is the highest of the seven gifts, for it makes us know and relish the things of God as divine truth, not merely as human truth. It is a participation in God's own knowledge - seeing all things from His perspective. This gift gives us a loving knowledge of God, making us savor His truths with delight and judge all things in relation to Him.

Come, Holy Spirit, and fill me with Your divine wisdom. May I see as You see, love as You love, and judge as You judge. Help me to savor the things of God, to find my greatest joy in His presence, and to evaluate everything by whether it draws me closer to Him. May Your wisdom order my life and guide all my choices.

The Beatitudes (Matthew 5:3-12)

Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
Blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted.
Blessed are the meek, for they shall inherit the earth.
Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, for they shall be satisfied.
Blessed are the merciful, for they shall obtain mercy.
Blessed are the pure in heart, for they shall see God.
Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called sons of God.
Blessed are those who are persecuted for righteousness' sake, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
Blessed are you when men revile you and persecute you and utter all kinds of evil against you falsely on my account. Rejoice and be glad, for your reward is great in heaven.
days.closing_prayer: O Holy Spirit, Spirit of wisdom, the highest and most precious of Your gifts, pour into our souls this divine treasure. May we know and love God with Your own knowledge and love; may we see all things in relation to Him and savor Him as our greatest good. Through Christ our Lord. Amen. Come, Holy Spirit! Fill the hearts of Your faithful and kindle in us the fire of Your love.
days.reflection: The Gift of Wisdom is the crown of all the gifts. It unites us most closely to God, enabling us to see and judge all things from His perspective. Wisdom makes us 'friends of God' who savor divine truth with supernatural delight. It is both a knowing and a loving - we don't just understand God, we taste and see His goodness.
days.intention_prayer: Holy Spirit, grant me the Gift of Wisdom, the crown of all Your gifts. Help me to see all things from Your perspective, to savor divine truth with delight, and to judge everything in relation to You. Draw me into deeper friendship with God. [Pause for personal intentions]
days.scripture: "But wisdom from above is first pure, then peaceable, gentle, open to reason, full of mercy and good fruits, without uncertainty or insincerity." - James 3:17

days.title: Day 8: The Fruits of the Holy Spirit
days.opening_prayer:
Veni Sancte Spiritus

Come, Holy Spirit, fill the hearts of Your faithful and kindle in them the fire of Your love.
V. Send forth Your Spirit, and they shall be created.
R. And You shall renew the face of the earth.

Let us pray: O God, who have taught the hearts of the faithful by the light of the Holy Spirit, grant that in the same Spirit we may be truly wise and ever rejoice in His consolation. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.
days.daily_prayer:
Holy Spirit, divine Fruit-bearer, I adore You as the source of all spiritual fruit. I thank You for every good fruit You have produced in my life. Today I implore You to bring forth in me the twelve fruits of the Spirit.

Your Word tells us: 'The fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness, self-control' (Galatians 5:22-23). The tradition also speaks of generosity, modesty, chastity, and charity. These fruits are the blessed effects of Your seven gifts working in a soul that is open to Your grace.

Come, Holy Spirit, and produce in me Your holy fruits.

Love - Help me to love God with my whole heart and my neighbor as myself.
Joy - Fill me with the joy of Your presence that no circumstance can steal.
Peace - Grant me the peace that surpasses understanding, the peace of being right with God.
Patience - Teach me to endure all things with tranquil trust in Your providence.
Kindness - Make me tender and compassionate toward all Your children.
Goodness - Form in me a generous heart that seeks to do good to all.
Faithfulness - Help me to be reliable and true to my commitments and to You.
Gentleness - Give me a mild and humble heart like that of Jesus.
Self-control - Strengthen me to master my passions and live a disciplined life.
Generosity - Free me from attachment to possessions that I may give freely.
Modesty - Help me to live with humility and simplicity.
Chastity - Purify my heart and body for Your glory.

Prayer for the Fruits

Holy Spirit, I open my soul to You like a branch to the sun. Produce in me the fruits that please the Father. May everyone who encounters me see in my life evidence of Your presence - love that is selfless, joy that is constant, peace that is unshakable, and all the virtues that mark Your children.
days.closing_prayer: O Holy Spirit, Spirit of abundant fruitfulness, pour into our souls the twelve fruits that mark Your presence. May our lives bear witness to You through love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness, self-control, generosity, modesty, and chastity. Through Christ our Lord. Amen. Come, Holy Spirit! Fill the hearts of Your faithful and kindle in us the fire of Your love.
days.reflection: The Fruits of the Holy Spirit are the visible signs of the Spirit's work in our lives. Just as a tree is known by its fruit, so is the Spirit-filled life. These fruits are not achieved through human effort alone but are supernatural dispositions that flow from the seven gifts. They make our lives beautiful, attractive, and conducive to the salvation of others.
days.intention_prayer: Holy Spirit, produce in me the fruits that please the Father. May my life show evidence of Your presence: love that is selfless, joy that is constant, peace that is unshakable, and all the virtues that mark Your children. [Pause for personal intentions]
days.scripture: "But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness, self-control; against such there is no law." - Galatians 5:22-23

days.title: Day 9: Pentecost - The Fullness of the Spirit
days.opening_prayer:
Sequence for Pentecost (Veni Sancte Spiritus)

Come, Holy Spirit, and send forth from heaven the ray of Your light.

Come, Father of the poor; come, Giver of gifts; come, Light of hearts.

You, best Consoler, sweet Guest of the soul, sweet Coolness.

In labor, rest; in heat, refreshment; in tears, solace.

O most blessed Light, fill the innermost hearts of Your faithful.

Without Your divine power, there is nothing in man, nothing innocent.

Cleanse what is base, water what is dry, heal what is wounded.

Bend what is rigid, warm what is cold, guide what goes astray.

Give to Your faithful, who trust in You, Your sevenfold gift.

Give the reward of virtue, give salvation in the end, give eternal joy. Amen. Alleluia.
days.daily_prayer:
Holy Spirit, divine Love who descended upon the Apostles at Pentecost, I adore You as the Soul of the Church and the Inspirer of souls. I thank You for Your coming upon the Blessed Virgin Mary and the Apostles, and for Your continuing presence in the Church and in my soul. Today, on this vigil of Pentecost, I implore You to renew Your wonders in me.

On that first Pentecost, You descended like tongues of fire upon the Apostles, transforming fearful men into bold witnesses. You filled the Upper Room with Your presence and the hearts of the disciples with Your power. From Jerusalem, the Gospel spread to all nations through Your inspiration.

Come, Holy Spirit, and fill me as You filled the Upper Room. Pour out upon me the fullness of Your seven gifts. Set my heart on fire with love for God and zeal for souls. Make me a witness to Christ in the world, an instrument of Your grace, and a channel of Your love.

The Sevenfold Gift of the Holy Spirit (Isaiah 11:1-3)

And there shall come forth a shoot from the stump of Jesse, and a branch shall grow out of his roots. And the Spirit of the Lord shall rest upon him, the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and the fear of the Lord. And his delight shall be in the fear of the Lord.

Prayer to Receive the Holy Spirit

Holy Spirit, I offer myself completely to You. Come with Your sanctifying gifts. Come with wisdom and understanding. Come with counsel and fortitude. Come with knowledge and piety. Come with the fear of the Lord. Fill me, transform me, use me. May I never resist Your inspirations or grieve Your presence. Let my life be a continual Pentecost, an ongoing reception of Your grace. I ask this through Christ our Lord and through the intercession of Mary, Spouse of the Holy Spirit. Amen.

Our Father, Hail Mary, Glory Be
days.closing_prayer:
Come, Holy Spirit, fill the hearts of Your faithful and kindle in them the fire of Your love. Send forth Your Spirit, and they shall be created. And You shall renew the face of the earth.

Let us pray: God, who by the light of the Holy Spirit instructed the hearts of the faithful, grant that in the same Spirit we may be truly wise and ever rejoice in His consolation. Through Christ our Lord. Amen. Veni Creator Spiritus:

Come, Holy Ghost, Creator blest,
And in our hearts take up Thy rest;
Come with Thy grace and heavenly aid,
To fill the hearts which Thou hast made.

Kindle our senses from above,
And make our hearts o'erflow with love;
With patience firm and virtue high
The weakness of our flesh supply.

Far from us drive our deadly foe,
True peace unto us bring;
And through all perils lead us safe
To heaven's eternal spring.

Through Thee may we the Father know,
Through Thee the eternal Son,
Thee also, Spirit of them both,
We worship, every one.

O Comforter, abide with us!
Our souls with grace divine;
Fill Thou the air with heavenly fire,
And bring forth Thee in shine.

Eternal glory be to Thee,
The Father, and the Son;
The same to Thee, great Comforter,
While endless ages run. Amen.
days.reflection: Pentecost marks the birthday of the Church and the fulfillment of Christ's promise to send the Advocate. The Apostles, transformed from fearful followers into bold proclaimers of the Gospel, launched the mission that continues to this day. Every Christian is called to be a 'pentecost person' - filled with the Spirit, on fire with love, and commissioned to bear witness to Christ. The fullness of the Spirit is not just for the great saints but for every baptized and confirmed Christian.
days.intention_prayer: Holy Spirit, come with all Your power. Fill me with Your sevenfold gift. Set my heart on fire with love for God and zeal for souls. Use me as You used the Apostles - to spread the Gospel and build up the Church. I offer myself entirely to You. [Pause for personal intentions]
days.scripture: "When the day of Pentecost had come, they were all together in one place. And suddenly a sound came from heaven like the rush of a mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting. And there appeared to them tongues as of fire, distributed and resting on each one of them. And they were all filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak in other tongues, as the Spirit gave them utterance." - Acts 2:1-4

source: Ancient tradition of the Church, dating to Apostolic times
notes: This is the original novena of the Catholic Church, commemorating the nine days of prayer by the Apostles and Mary in the Upper Room from Ascension to Pentecost. The novena is traditionally prayed from the Friday after Ascension Thursday to the Saturday before Pentecost. The seven gifts of the Holy Spirit (Isaiah 11:2-3) are wisdom, understanding, counsel, fortitude, knowledge, piety, and fear of the Lord. The twelve fruits of the Spirit (Galatians 5:22-23) are love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness, self-control, generosity, modesty, and chastity. Special prayers used include the Veni Sancte Spiritus (Come Holy Spirit), the Veni Creator Spiritus (Come Creator Spirit - attributed to Rabanus Maurus, 9th century), and the Sequence for Pentecost. The novena is especially powerful when combined with a sincere desire to grow in holiness and openness to the Spirit's action in one's life.
